title: Rib arch, rooted in the water
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for Widow's Bay.
A single huge curved whale rib, ivory and grey, as a free-standing foreground flat. Its base dissolves softly into murky water at the bottom edge (no hard cut-off bottom edge, no rocks), and it curves up and over to the right. Leave the top quarter free of any ledge or spur (the game adds rib-ledge where the sailor stands). Replaces rib-arch, whose straight-cut base floats in mid-air on high ledges. Flat painted toy-theatre cut-out seen square-on, gouache on card with a faint pale cut edge; early-1900s stencil-tinted colour: sepia-grey line and tone with translucent washes of plum #2a1424, rose pink #f3c6dc, magenta #e0127a, moon gold #d9b34a, coral red #c8321e and grotto teal #5f8c88 laid slightly out of register; no cast shadow; no lettering; isolated on a transparent background (or flat pure magenta #FF00FF if transparency is unavailable).
Requested final aspect ratio 900:1800. Real transparent alpha outside the isolated art.
Input image is a style/palette reference; follow the written subject and geometry rather than reproducing unwanted elements.
No text or watermark. Reference is bone texture only. Smooth unobstructed curved rib, no ledge anywhere near top. Base fades into genuine alpha.
